_what: Settings for one video. Copy to projects/<name>/project.json and fill in. Never commit the real one.
_sync: Filled in by 03_sync.py. Seconds into the face video where the screen recording starts, and how much faster the screen clock runs.
_status_bar: Pixels of phone status bar (time, signal, battery) to crop off the top of the screen recording. 80 for a 864 x 1920 recording.
_cuts: Word ranges to cut, from 05_sentences.py. Each is [first word, last word, why]. Approved by Anthony before 06_edl.py runs.
_cut_times: Fillers cut by time, in seconds of the face video: [start, end, why]. From 05b_find_fillers.py.
_speed: His speech speed. 1.1 since 2026-11-05 (his choice). Skill speed-change.
_privacy: Lower case. surnames: blurred. always_blur: blurred fully. keep: left readable (a public business account).
_overlays: Word numbers come from 05_sentences.py. Step labels and tip cards appear on that word.
tips: Ask Claude to interview you first
_layout: The opening, tied to word numbers: where the face is and what the card shows. The screen recording segment is added on its own.
_moments: Named moments the B-roll animations use: [word number, seconds offset].
